pages.d: ncode is a native Mac app where AI agents read, write and run code in your projects, and every run, agent and step shows its progress.
s: ncode is a coding assistant that lives in a window on your Mac. You open a project folder, say what you want, and agents read the code, edit files and run commands to get it done. Nothing is hidden:…
What you can do with it
Chat about your code. Ask questions, get explanations, and let the assistant make changes you can review. Plan first. Plan mode uses read-only tools to write a step-by-step plan you approve before…

When you send a message, ncode starts a run. A run has one top agent: the assistant, a planner or a swarm lead. That agent works in steps: it thinks, then calls tools (read a file, edit a file, run a…
ncode does not come with a model or an account. You bring an API key for Anthropic or for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, a local Ollama or LM Studio server, and…
A Mac with Apple silicon (arm64). macOS 15 or later. An API key for a model provider.
The same engine is available as a terminal app, ncode, which shares the app's projects, conversations and settings. See Using with the CLI, Install the CLI and the CLI docs.
Install ncode. Add your key and send a first message. Take a tour of the window.

pages.d: The rail, the sidebar, the transcript, the agents pane and the side chat: what each part of the ncode window shows and how to move around.

pages.d: Use Plan mode to get a read-only, step-by-step plan, then approve it for one agent or a swarm, revise it, or decline it.
s: When a change is big or risky, ask for a plan first. In Plan mode the agent can only read and search; it answers with a step-by-step plan and changes nothing until you approve it.

pages.d: Split a big task between several agents working in parallel, with a lead that plans, delegates, checks the work and reports.
